chunks: Abdul Wahid ibn Abdullah narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Qarashi narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated to me, from Huthayfa ibn al-Mansoor, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he said:

Indeed, for Allah there is a banquet (and in another narration: a feast) in Qarqisiya, a caller from the sky will appear and call out: O birds of the sky and O beasts of the earth, come to be satiated from the flesh of the tyrants.

key_terms.قَرْقِسِيَاء: A place name, often identified with a region in Syria or Mesopotamia

ai.seo_question: What is the divine banquet of Qarqisiya mentioned in Shia eschatology?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* describes a miraculous divine banquet in Qarqisiya, where birds and beasts consume the flesh of the tyrants (al-Jabbarin) as a prelude to the Mahdi's appearance. It highlights the cosmic scale of divine justice, where creation itself participates in the subjugation of oppressors, a theme deeply rooted in Shia eschatological expectations of the end times.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (63) Abdul Wahid bin Abdullah narrated from Muhammad bin Ja’far al-Qarashi from Muhammad bin al-Husayn bin Abul Khattab from Muhammad bin Sinan from Huthayfa bin al-Mansoor that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said: “Allah will have a banquet.
A caller from the Heaven will call out: O birds of the sky and beasts of the earth, come to eat and be satiate of the flesh of the tyrants.”
